text:
olivia: Quick sync request 10am PT tomorrow with vendor PMs to finalize launch cadence for H100/H200, B200, MI300, Gaudi. Need to confirm embargo windows, marketplace pre-listing, and SI integration timeline.

dan: I can cover Marketplace flow. We want hidden listings for SI onboarding + metadata for quotas. Need stable image tags from infra.

priya: On infra side, driver GA date still tentative. Vendors gave ranges: Nvidia end of month, AMD MI300 mid-Apr, Gaudi early Apr. We'll get nightly canary builds but GA may slip.

marco: SI perspective: we need 2 full dry-run cycles before public. Prefer to do SI dry-run the week before the blog. Also need sample workloads and perf targets.

olivia: Proposal: set soft windows with slack fallback. If any vendor slips, we move H200 public -> +7 days and do rapid routing to H100/B200 in Dedicated while we stabilize.

dan: Marketplace constraints: we can publish a hidden SKU if image_tag starts with "canary-" and has a signed bill-of-materials. We'll add a field `prelist_visibility: hidden`.

priya: I'll expose nightly canary URLs and add CI badges. Will attach a `driver_signoff` label when QA passes.

marco: Lab availability: Gaudi racks limited Apr 4-9. Can reserve two SI slots/day. Need signups by EOD Fri.

olivia: Marketing asks for 72h embargo review on partner quotes (vendors asked for 48h, but we prefer 72h to be safe). Anyone object?

dan: 72h is fine. Add `quote_review_window: 72h` to runbook.

priya: Ops routing snippet (we'll push as policy):
```
routing_policy:
  primary: H200
  fallback: [H100, B200]
  ttl_days: 14
```
This allows automatic downgrade while preserving performance tiers.

marco: SI checklist highlights: smoke test suite, latency p95 threshold, batch stability, KV cache correctness, checkpoint restore. I'll post matrix.

olivia: Action owners: Dan -> marketplace prelist + SKU metadata; Priya -> canary CI + driver_signoff flag; Marco -> SI signup sheet + smoke test matrix; Olivia -> embargo runbook + vendor opt-in.

partner-bot: Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1723456780-hw-roadmap-lock (invite created) :white_check_mark:

priya: Small ask: can we add a required artifact `signed_driver_checksum` before marketplace visibility flips to public? Saves us from bad images.

dan: Yes. We'll gate publish on `signed_driver_checksum` + `vendor_quote_review_complete`.

olivia: We'll hold comms until embargos clear. Dry run with vendors + SI scheduled Tue 10am PT; please add agenda items.

marco: I'll include a short demo plan and rollback steps.

dan: Also adding SKU pricing caveat for Dedicated capacity (min commit window 30 days) into listing metadata.

olivia: Thanks all. If vendor dates move, ping this thread and we'll re-run the cadence. :rocket:
